recent: GTA Holdings 与 Safran 签署谅解备忘录，探讨直升机维修与培训服务合作，并延长与 Gading Kasturi 的发动机支持协议至2028年。公司于2026年9月完成首次公开募股（IPO），随后多名董事及主要股东（包括 Lembaga Tabung Angkatan Tentera）申报股权变动。最新季度（截至2026年6月30日）营收为5439万令吉，净利403万令吉。
notable: 与 Safran 签署谅解备忘录，探讨提供直升机维修与培训服务。

risks: Lembaga Tabung Angkatan Tentera 于2026年9月多次申报股权变动。
多名董事及主要股东于2026年9月申报股权变动，包括在IPO粉表分配中认购股份。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度，营收为5439万令吉，净利403万令吉，净利率7.4%。

recent_en: GTA Holdings signed an MOU with Safran to explore helicopter repair and training services, and extended its engine support agreement with Gading Kasturi to 2028. The company completed its IPO in September 2026, followed by shareholding change disclosures from several directors and substantial shareholders, including Lembaga Tabung Angkatan Tentera. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR54.39 million and net profit was MYR4.03 million.
notable_en: Signed an MOU with Safran to explore providing helicopter repair and training services.
Extended the helicopter engine support agreement until September 2028.
Completed its initial public offering (IPO) in September 2026.
risks_en: Lembaga Tabung Angkatan Tentera made multiple shareholding change disclosures in September 2026.
Several directors and substantial shareholders disclosed shareholding changes in September 2026, including subscriptions under the IPO pink form allocation.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR54.39 million, net profit was MYR4.03 million, with a net margin of 7.4%.
